title: An absolute include inside an imported project file resolves against that project
rule: A path starting with / inside an imported project's file resolves from that project's root.

citations.quote: When you include a file that includes other files, all the includes are resolved before the file is passed on to the next project that includes it.
Absolute path starting from current project's root.

rationale: The includes of an imported file are resolved within its own project before the file reaches the importing project, and / is the root of the current project.
